items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: The interviewee identifies herself as Richard Binion Allen ('My real name is Richard Binion Allen'). The transcript contains no mention of any other person named Richard Binion Allen, nor does it describe a relationship with anyone else by that name.

ctx.x: My name is Joel Palmer, and your name?
My name is, well everybody calls me Dick Allen. My real name is Richard Binion Allen, but I didn't want to tell anybody.
Alright, well we all know now.
